summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a comprehensive financing package entered into with Mudrick Capital and Yorkville, including a senior secured convertible notes facility of up to $50 million, a convertible preferred equity facility of up to $250 million, and an equity line of credit of up to $500 million. The filing details the terms of the supplemental indenture, note purchase agreement, and securities purchase agreement, but these are financing arrangements, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant is the issuer of these securities. No special situation event is triggered; the filing is a routine current report of financing transactions.
